description: Run the Open WebUI Pipelines server in Docker bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:9099. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. Drop your LangChain/LlamaIndex pipeline .py files into ~/.mobilessh/pipelines to expose them as models; they reach the host Ollama via http://host.docker.internal:11434.

steps.description: Make sure the AI Chat plugin's Ollama is running on 127.0.0.1:11434 (start it if installed). Install the AI Chat plugin first if this reports it missing.
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434; nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; fi; echo "Ollama not reachable on 127.0.0.1:11434 — install/run the AI Chat plugin first (it sets up Ollama with no root)."

steps.description: Pull the model used by the bundled example pipeline (llama3.2) with Ollama.
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1 && ollama pull llama3.2 || echo "Ollama CLI not found — install the AI Chat plugin first."

steps.description: Start the Open WebUI Pipelines container bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:9099 (pipeline files in the Docker volume "pipelines").
steps.run: docker rm -f pipelines 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name pipelines --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:9099:9099 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v pipelines:/app/pipelines ghcr.io/open-webui/pipelines:main

steps.description: Install a bundled example pipeline (LangChain → local Ollama, exposed as an OpenAI model) into the Pipelines server and reload it.
Wait for the Pipelines server to answer.
steps.run: for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer 0p3n-w3bu!" http://127.0.0.1:9099/v1/models >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "Pipelines still starting — give it a moment."

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the Pipelines container and its pipeline volume.
uninstall.run: docker rm -f pipelines 2>/dev/null || true; docker volume rm pipelines 2>/dev/null || true
